title: Morning Sip
invite: Want to wake up our brains with a few sips of water together?

steps.text: Find your cup or water bottle
tiny: Look on your nightstand or desk first
If you can't find it, any clean cup counts

steps.text: Fill it with water from the tap or fridge
tiny: Carry your cup to the tap or fridge
Fill it up most of the way

steps.text: Take 3 sips

title: Meds & Vitamins
invite: Want to grab your meds with me? It only takes a moment.

steps.text: Walk to the spot where you keep your meds
Get a glass of water ready
Take today's meds with a sip of water
tiny: Put today's meds in your hand
Swallow them with a sip of water

steps.text: Close the container and put it back in its spot

title: Brush Teeth (Morning)
invite: Want to do a minty-fresh brush so we both feel sparkly?

steps.text: Walk to the bathroom sink
Squeeze a pea-sized dot of toothpaste onto your brush
tiny: Squeeze a pea-sized dot onto the bristles

steps.text: Brush your top teeth for about 1 minute
tiny: Brush the outside of the top teeth
Brush the inside of the top teeth

steps.text: Brush your bottom teeth for about 1 minute
tiny: Brush the outside of the bottom teeth
Brush the inside of the bottom teeth

steps.text: Spit, rinse the brush, and put it back
tiny: Rinse the brush under the tap
Put the brush back in its cup

title: Face Splash Reset
invite: A cool splash can feel nice. Want to try one with me?

steps.text: Turn on the tap and find a temperature that feels okay
tiny: Hold one finger in the water
Turn it warmer or cooler until it feels okay

steps.text: Splash your face with water two times
Pat your face dry with a towel
If you use lotion or moisturizer, rub in a small dot
tiny: Put a small dot on your fingertip

title: Get Dressed
invite: Want to pick some comfy clothes for today? Soft ones count.

steps.text: Pick one top and one pair of bottoms
tiny: Take the first comfy top you see
Take the first comfy bottoms you see

steps.text: Grab clean socks and underwear
tiny: Open your sock drawer and take one pair
Open your underwear drawer and take one pair

steps.text: Put them on, one piece at a time
Put your pajamas on your pillow or in the hamper

title: Easy Breakfast
invite: Want to give your body some fuel? Anything easy counts.

steps.text: Pick one easy food: toast, yogurt, a banana, cereal, or a bar
tiny: Pick the first easy food you see

steps.text: Get it ready on a plate or in a bowl
tiny: Take out a plate or bowl

steps.text: Sit down and eat it
Put the dish in the sink

title: Pack Your Bag
invite: Want to pack our bag so future-you has everything?

steps.text: Put your keys, phone, and wallet or ID in the bag
tiny: Put your keys in the bag
Put your phone in the bag
Put your wallet or ID in the bag

steps.text: Add your charger
Add your water bottle
Add anything today needs: homework, lunch, or work things
tiny: Think of one thing today needs
Put that one thing in the bag
Check for one more, or zip the bag

steps.text: Set the bag by the door

title: Launch Pad Check
invite: Quick pocket check before we head out? Keys, phone, wallet.

steps.text: Touch your keys
Touch your phone
Touch your wallet or ID
Ask yourself: did I take my meds?
Head out the door gently

title: Brush Teeth (Night)
invite: Want to brush teeth together so I can get cozy for sleep?

steps.text: Walk to the bathroom sink
Squeeze a pea-sized dot of toothpaste onto your brush
tiny: Squeeze a pea-sized dot onto the bristles

steps.text: Brush all your teeth for about 2 minutes
tiny: Brush your top teeth for about 1 minute
Brush your bottom teeth for about 1 minute

steps.text: Spit, rinse the brush, and put it back
tiny: Rinse the brush under the tap
Put the brush back in its cup

title: Cozy Clothes Swap
invite: Want to change into something soft and comfy?

steps.text: Find your pajamas or soft clothes
Take off today's clothes
Put dirty clothes in the hamper
Put on the soft clothes

title: Plug In Your Phone
invite: Want to tuck your phone in for the night, like I tuck in?

steps.text: Find your charger
Plug your phone in
Check your alarm for tomorrow
Put your phone face down

title: Tomorrow-Me Setup
invite: Want to leave a little gift for tomorrow-you?

steps.text: Look at tomorrow on your calendar or planner
Lay out tomorrow's clothes
tiny: Pick one top and one pair of bottoms

steps.text: Put your bag by the door
Write one thing to remember on a sticky note
tiny: Grab a sticky note and a pen
Write one word to remind you
Stick it on your door or phone

title: Wind-Down Ritual
invite: Want to slow things down with me? I'll dim my room too.

steps.text: Turn off the big light and use a small lamp
Turn your screen brightness down or switch on night mode
Drink a little water
Get into bed and take 5 slow breaths
tiny: Breathe in slowly, then out slowly, 5 times

title: Evening Meds
invite: Any evening meds today? Want to take them together?

steps.text: Walk to the spot where you keep your meds
Take tonight's meds with a sip of water
tiny: Put tonight's meds in your hand
Swallow them with a sip of water

steps.text: Close the container and put it back

title: Shower Quest
invite: Want a warm, cozy rinse? We can go one tiny step at a time.

steps.text: Grab a towel and clean clothes and bring them to the bathroom
Turn on the water and check that the temperature feels good
tiny: Turn it warmer or cooler until it feels good

steps.text: Step in and get your hair and body wet
tiny: Stand under the water until your hair and body are wet

steps.text: Shampoo your hair, then rinse it
tiny: Squeeze a coin-sized blob of shampoo into your hand
Rub it into your hair for a few seconds
Rinse until the bubbles are gone

steps.text: Soap your body, then rinse
tiny: Put soap on your hands or a cloth
Rinse until the soap is gone

steps.text: Turn off the water, dry off, and get dressed

title: Dishes & Kitchen Reset
invite: Want to tackle a few dishes together so I can power up?

steps.text: Put any trash on the counter into the bin
tiny: Grab the first piece of trash
Repeat until the counter is clear

steps.text: Rinse the plates
tiny: Hold one plate under the water
Set it down and do the next one

steps.text: Load or wash just 5 items
tiny: Wash it or put it in the dishwasher

steps.text: Wipe the counter with a cloth or paper towel
tiny: Grab a cloth or paper towel
Wipe from one end of the counter to the other

title: Unload the Dishwasher
invite: Want to put clean dishes away with me? Plates first.

steps.text: Open the dishwasher and pull out the bottom rack
Put the plates and bowls away
tiny: Do the same with the bowls

steps.text: Put the cups and glasses away
tiny: Repeat until the cups are gone

steps.text: Put the forks, spoons, and knives away
Close the dishwasher

title: Fridge Check-In
invite: Want to peek in the fridge together and say bye to old food?

steps.text: Open the fridge and take out anything old or smelly
tiny: Take out anything old or smelly from it

steps.text: Put the old food in the trash
Wipe one shelf
Write down 3 things you are out of
tiny: Grab paper or your phone's notes
Write the first thing you're out of

title: Take Out the Trash
invite: Want to walk the trash out with me? Fresh air bonus.

steps.text: Tie the trash bag closed
Lift the bag out of the bin
Put a new bag in the bin
Carry the full bag to the outside bin
tiny: Drop it in the big bin

title: Make a Simple Meal
invite: Want to make something easy to eat? Simple is perfect.

steps.text: Pick one: pasta, a rice bowl, a sandwich, or a frozen meal
Take out the ingredients you need
Make it by following the package or your usual way
tiny: Read and do the next one

steps.text: Sit down and eat
Put your dishes in the sink

title: Grocery Run
invite: Want to plan a little food adventure? A short list is plenty.

steps.text: Look in the fridge and cupboards
tiny: Open the fridge and look inside
Open one cupboard and look inside

steps.text: Write a list of 5 to 10 things you need
tiny: Open a notes app or grab paper
Write the first thing you need

steps.text: Grab bags, wallet, keys, and phone
tiny: Put your wallet, keys, and phone in your pocket

steps.text: Go to the store
tiny: Walk or drive to the store

steps.text: Find the things on your list
tiny: Find the first thing on the list
Cross it off and find the next one

steps.text: At home, put cold things in the fridge first
tiny: Put the cold things in the fridge
Put the frozen things in the freezer
Put everything else on the counter

title: Laundry Quest
invite: Want to start a cozy laundry load with me? I'll remind you when it's ready.

steps.text: Gather your dirty clothes into a basket
tiny: Pick up clothes from the floor

steps.text: Load the washer, add detergent, and press start
tiny: Put the clothes in the washer
Pour in one cap of detergent
Close the lid and press start

steps.text: Move the wet clothes to the dryer
tiny: Grab an armful of wet clothes
Repeat until the washer is empty

steps.text: Grab a dryer sheet and toss it in
Clean the lint trap and start the dryer
tiny: Wipe the fluff off with your fingers
Close the door and press start

steps.text: Take the clothes out and fold or hang just 5 things
tiny: Open the dryer and pull the clothes into a basket

title: Put Clean Clothes Away
invite: Want to give your clean clothes a home? Hangers first.

steps.text: Carry the basket to your room
Hang up anything that goes on a hanger
tiny: Find one thing that goes on a hanger

steps.text: Fold shirts and put them in a drawer
Put socks and underwear in their drawer
tiny: Put the socks in their drawer
Put the underwear in their drawer

title: Fresh Sheets
invite: Want to make a fresh, crisp bed to flop into tonight?

steps.text: Take the pillowcases off
Pull off the sheet
tiny: Pull up one corner of the sheet
Pull the sheet off the bed

steps.text: Carry the old sheets to the washer
Put on a clean sheet
tiny: Hook one corner of the clean sheet over the mattress

steps.text: Put clean pillowcases on

title: Clean Bedroom
invite: Want to give your room a little glow-up? Trash first, then clothes, then surfaces.

steps.text: Grab a trash bag
Pick up all the trash you can see
tiny: Pick up trash on the floor
Pick up trash on the bed
Pick up trash on the desk and nightstand

steps.text: Pick up clothes: dirty ones go in the hamper, clean ones go on a chair
tiny: Pick up one piece of clothing
Dirty? Into the hamper. Clean? Onto the chair.
Keep going until the floor is clear

steps.text: Clear one surface, like your desk or nightstand
tiny: Put everything on it into a pile
Put back only what lives there

steps.text: Wipe that surface with a cloth
tiny: Wipe the surface from one side to the other

title: 5-Minute Desk Tidy
invite: Want to clear a little space for your brain to breathe?

steps.text: Take any cups or dishes to the kitchen
tiny: Pick up the cups and dishes
Carry them to the kitchen sink

steps.text: Put trash in the bin
Stack loose papers into one pile
Put pens and pencils in one cup

title: Quick Bathroom Wipe
invite: Want to give the bathroom a tiny sparkle with me?

steps.text: Grab cleaning wipes or a spray and a cloth
tiny: Find the wipes or the spray

steps.text: Wipe the sink
Wipe the toilet seat and handle
Hang your towel up straight

title: Floor Rescue
invite: Want to rescue 10 things from the floor? I'll count with you.

steps.text: Pick up 10 things from the floor and put them on the bed
Put away anything that has an obvious home
tiny: Pick one thing from the bed

steps.text: Put everything else in one basket for later

title: Water the Plants
invite: Want to give your plant friends a drink?

steps.text: Fill a cup or watering can with water
Touch the soil of each plant: if it's dry, give it water
tiny: Push one finger into the soil
If it feels dry, pour in some water
Move on to the next plant

steps.text: Put the watering can back

title: Feed Your Pet
invite: Want to feed your real-life buddy too? They'd love that.

steps.text: Check your pet's food bowl
Add one scoop of food
Give them fresh water
Tell them they're a good friend

title: Water Break
invite: Want to have a water break with me? I'm thirsty too.

steps.text: Fill a cup with water
Drink half of it

title: Wiggle & Stretch
invite: Want to do a silly little stretch? I'll wiggle too.

steps.text: Stand up
Reach your arms up high for 5 seconds
Roll your shoulders 5 times
Shake out your hands

title: Sensory Reset Break
invite: Feeling like too much? Want to find a quiet corner with me?

steps.text: Go to a quiet spot
Put on headphones or earplugs if you have them
Turn down the lights or close your eyes
Take 10 slow breaths
Choose what feels good: stim, rest, or a drink of water

title: Hard Day Kit
invite: Low-spoon day? These are the only things that matter today.

steps.text: Drink some water
Eat anything (a snack totally counts)
Take your meds if you have them
Change into something comfy
Rest. That's the whole quest.

title: Step Outside
invite: Want to say hi to the sky with me for a minute?

steps.text: Put on shoes
Open the door and step outside
Take 5 slow breaths
Notice 3 things you can see

title: Pay Monthly Bills
invite: Want to knock out one bill together? Just one is a real win.

steps.text: Open your bank app or website
tiny: Tap the bank app (or go to the bank's website)

steps.text: Write a list of bills due this month: rent, phone, internet, and others
tiny: Grab paper or open your notes

steps.text: Pay the first bill on the list
tiny: Find the pay button for the first bill

steps.text: Take a screenshot of the confirmation
Pay the next one, or stop here for today

title: Gather Tax Documents
invite: Want to start a tax folder together? Just gathering, no filling out yet.

steps.text: Make a folder (paper or on your computer) called "Taxes" plus this year
tiny: Grab a folder or open your computer files

steps.text: Search your email for the word "tax"
Save any income forms (like a W-2 or 1099) into the folder
tiny: Open the first email with a tax form

steps.text: Add receipts you might need
tiny: Think of one receipt you might need

steps.text: Write down any questions for whoever helps you file

title: Doctor Appointment Call
invite: Want to book that appointment together? I have a script ready for you.

steps.text: Find the clinic's phone number or online booking page
tiny: Search the clinic's name on your phone
Find the phone number or booking button

steps.text: Write down 2 or 3 days and times you are free
tiny: Write down 2 or 3 times you are free

steps.text: Read this script out loud once: "Hi, I'd like to book an appointment. My name is ___ and my birthday is ___."
Make the call or use the online booking
tiny: Read the script when they answer
Pick one of your free times

steps.text: Add the appointment to your calendar
tiny: Add the date, time, and clinic name

title: Reply to Messages
invite: Want to send just one reply? One sentence is plenty.

steps.text: Open one messaging app
Pick the easiest message to answer
Type a one-sentence reply (that's enough)
Press send

title: Inbox Peek
invite: Want to peek at your inbox with me? No need to read everything.

steps.text: Open your email
Delete or archive 5 obvious junk emails
tiny: Tap the first obvious junk email

steps.text: Star 1 important email
Reply to one email, or leave it for later
tiny: Type a short reply, or close it for later

title: Money Peek
invite: Want to take a calm look at your money? Just looking, no judging.

steps.text: Open your bank app
Look at your balance
Read your last 5 purchases
Write down anything that surprised you
tiny: Grab paper or your notes app
Write down one purchase that surprised you

title: Check the Week Ahead
invite: Want to peek at the week together so nothing sneaks up on us?

steps.text: Open your calendar or planner
Read each day of the coming week
tiny: Look at each day after it, one at a time

steps.text: Add anything that's missing
tiny: Think of one thing that's missing
Add it to the right day

steps.text: Pick the one day that needs the most energy and circle it

title: Refill Prescriptions
invite: Want to check your meds so you never run out?

steps.text: Count how many days of meds you have left
tiny: Divide by how many you take each day

steps.text: Open your pharmacy app or find their phone number
tiny: Or search the pharmacy's phone number

steps.text: Request the refill
Put the pickup day in your calendar
tiny: Add "Pick up meds" on the pickup day

title: Homework Start
invite: Want to just open the homework with me? Opening it is the whole first step.

steps.text: Open the assignment
tiny: Open your laptop, app, or backpack

steps.text: Get a pen or your laptop ready
tiny: Grab a pen or open your laptop
Put it right in front of you

steps.text: Read only the first question
Write anything for the first answer (messy is fine)
tiny: Pick up your pen or put your hands on the keys
Write the first few words that come to mind

steps.text: Keep going for 10 minutes, or stop here

title: One Focus Sprint
invite: Want to do one short focus sprint? I'll keep time and nudge you when it's done.

steps.text: Pick one task
Put your phone face down or in another room
Start working; I'll nudge you in 15 minutes
Stand up, stretch, and drink some water

title: Start the Work Block
invite: Want to ease into the work block? Just five gentle minutes.

steps.text: Open your to-do list
Pick the tiniest task on it
Close any tabs you don't need
tiny: Close any others you don't need

steps.text: Work on it for 5 minutes

title: Cozy Corner Reset
invite: Want to make one corner feel cozy before bed?

steps.text: Fold the blanket on the couch
tiny: Fold it in half, then in half again

steps.text: Put the pillows back where they go
Take any cups to the kitchen
